articles.title: Hire, fire, final - Chelsea's player power may be ugly, but it wins
articles.summary: Chelsea are in another FA Cup final - but only after their players showed up in a way they were no longer doing for Liam Rosenior, writes Phil McNulty.

articles.title: Arsenal 'on a mission' - is another special season on the horizon?
articles.summary: The Gunners are one game away from a second successive Women's Champions League final, and are also still in the Women's Super League title race.

articles.title: Fernandez fires Chelsea to FA Cup final showdown with Man City
articles.summary: Enzo Fernandez' first-half header gives Chelsea a 1-0 win over Leeds United in the semi-final of the FA Cup at Wembley Stadium.

articles.title: Will doubters believe in Hearts' title chances now?
articles.summary: Some have waited all season for Hearts to falter. Plenty thought it might be at Easter Road. But Derek McInnes' side are still going, writes Tom English.

articles.title: Italian referee chief suspends himself over allegations
articles.summary: The man in charge of assigning referees in Italy's top flight suspends himself after it is alleged he is under investigation for sporting fraud.

articles.title: Why Rashford must be patient over Barcelona future
articles.summary: Marcus Rashford is not ready to give up on his Barcelona dream just yet, writes Spanish football expert Guillem Balague.

articles.title: Police 'aware' of video appearing to show York player punching fan
articles.summary: Police say they are aware of a video circulating online that appears to show a York City player punching a fan during the club's dramatic 1-1 draw with Rochdale on Saturday.

articles.title: Arsenal capitalise on defensive errors  to secure first leg win over Lyon
articles.summary: Arsenal pounce on a pair of defensive errors to come from behind to defeat Lyon 2-1 at the Emirates Stadium, in the first leg of their Women's Champions League semi-final.

articles.title: Record-equalling Kerr helps Chelsea dominate Everton
articles.summary: Sam Kerr scores twice to join former teammate Fran Kirby in being Chelsea's joint all-time top goalscorer in the WSL, as Sonia Bompastor's side soundly defeat Everton 4-1 at Goodison Park.

articles.title: Williamson calls for Arsenal 'intensity' in second leg
articles.summary: Leah Williamson believes Arsenal will have to be "really clinical" and "defensively secure" if they are to maintain their lead in the second leg of their Women's Champions League semi-final away to Lyon.
